description: Implementation of trigger handling for the Bosch BMI160 inertial measurement unit driver, including interrupt handling, trigger configuration, and thread management.

methods.name: bmi160_handle_anymotion
methods.description: Handles any motion interrupt event for BMI160.

methods.name: bmi160_handle_drdy
methods.description: Handles data ready interrupt for accelerometer and gyroscope.

methods.name: bmi160_handle_interrupts
methods.description: Processes interrupt status and calls appropriate handlers.

methods.name: bmi160_thread_main
methods.description: Main thread loop for handling BMI160 interrupts when using own thread.

methods.name: bmi160_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for global thread interrupt processing.

methods.name: bmi160_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt pin change.

methods.name: bmi160_trigger_drdy_set
methods.description: Configures data ready trigger for specified sensor channel.
